combined_rule_warning: Individually chosen slot rules must not be summed or described as a combined improvement. A separate simultaneous pre-quota full-portfolio replay is required because replacements, capital contention, same-symbol exclusion, G7 Nifty/V4 gates, and the daily loss lock interact.
protocol_ambiguity: The frozen protocol specifies development selection and later reporting but no numeric later-period acceptance gate. Later figures are evaluation only and are not relabeled as a formal qualification.
sample_size_warning: Point win rate above 75% does not establish a true rate above 75% when the Wilson lower bound is below 75%; repeated inspection of the same 59 sessions further weakens generalization.
